adjudication.rationale: In `spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb`, the “no previous embed” test sets `TopicRetriever.expects(:new).returns(retriever)` without asserting the expected constructor argument (e.g., `with(embed_url, ...)`), so it would still pass even if `EmbedController#best` called `TopicRetriever.new` with the wrong URL. It also doesn’t assert that the controller renders the `loading` template when `TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed` returns `nil` (the controller explicitly does `render 'loading'` in that branch), so rendering the wrong template could slip by. The note about `no_throttle: user.try(:staff?)` in `retrieve_topic.rb` is also a coverage gap (that behavior isn’t exercised by this controller spec).
